notes: Finished piece images ready to place on a board. Each piece sits on a clear background so the board shows through. Paths are relative to this catalogue file. Layout: <color>/<material>/<color>_<type>.png. A material set is complete when it has all six types for both colors.

sets.label: Playdough
sets.theme: soft matte modeling clay, handmade Staunton
sets.read: Matte modeling-clay army with rounded edges and a soft handmade surface. Black side is dark gray dough. White side is off-white cream dough. Silhouettes follow classic Staunton cues so each type stays readable on a board.

king.read: Dark gray clay king with stacked body rings, coronet, and a clear cross finial. Soft matte surface; the reference piece for this material set.

queen.read: Dark gray clay queen with coronet crown and ball finial on a ringed Staunton body.

rook.read: Dark gray clay rook with crenellated battlement top and a wide base.

bishop.read: Dark gray clay bishop with mitre top, diagonal slit, and ball finial.

knight.read: Dark gray clay knight as a rounded horse head on a pedestal base, facing roughly to the right.

pawn.read: Dark gray clay pawn with ball head, simple collar ring, and wide base.

king.read: Off-white cream clay king with coronet and cross finial; light twin of the black king.

queen.read: Off-white clay queen with coronet and ball finial on a ringed body.

rook.read: Off-white clay rook with clear battlements and a wide base.

bishop.read: Off-white clay bishop with mitre, diagonal slit, and ball finial.

knight.read: Off-white clay knight horse head on a pedestal base.

pawn.read: Off-white clay pawn with ball head and simple collar.

sets.label: Robotech Anime
sets.read: Hard-edged anime chess army with cel shading and a Robotech mecha flavor. Black side is dark charcoal armor. White side is pale white and light gray armor. Silhouettes stay classic Staunton so each type reads clearly on a board. The knight leans more mechanical than the other pieces.

king.read: Dark charcoal anime king with coronet and cross finial, smooth cel-shaded armor panels.

queen.read: Dark charcoal anime queen with coronet crown and ball finial on a tall Staunton body.

rook.read: Dark charcoal anime rook tower with crenellated top and a wide armored base.

bishop.read: Dark charcoal anime bishop with mitre, diagonal slit, and ball finial.

knight.read: Dark mecha horse-head knight with segmented armor plates and a glowing green eye accent.

pawn.read: Dark charcoal anime pawn with ball head, simple collar, and wide base.

king.read: Pale white anime king with coronet and cross finial; light twin of the black king.

queen.read: Pale white anime queen with coronet and ball finial.

rook.read: Pale white anime rook with clear battlements and a wide base.

bishop.read: Pale white anime bishop with mitre, diagonal slit, and ball finial.

knight.read: Pale mecha horse-head knight with segmented armor plates on a pedestal base.

pawn.read: Pale white anime pawn with ball head and simple collar.

sets.label: African Fauna
sets.theme: cartoon African animals as Staunton chess pieces
sets.read: Cute cartoon African animals on classic chess bodies. Black side uses charcoal and gold split paint. White side uses cream ivory. Each type is a different animal: king lion, queen lioness, rook giraffe, bishop elephant, knight zebra, pawn meerkat. Faces look at the camera. Full figure stays in frame.

king.read: Cartoon lion king with dark mane, crown and cross, charcoal-and-gold body.

queen.read: Cartoon lioness queen with coronet and ball finial, no heavy mane, split dark body.

rook.read: Cartoon giraffe rook with ossicones and spotted neck on a tall chess body.

bishop.read: Cartoon elephant bishop with ears, trunk, small tusks, and a mitre-like cap.

knight.read: Cartoon zebra knight in horse-head pose with bold stripes and dark base.

pawn.read: Cartoon meerkat pawn standing on a dark pedestal with a simple collar ring.

king.read: Cartoon lion king with warm mane, crown and cross, cream ivory body.

queen.read: Cartoon lioness queen with coronet and ball finial on a cream body.

rook.read: Cartoon giraffe rook with soft spots and ossicones on a cream tower body.

bishop.read: Cartoon elephant bishop with ears, trunk, tusks, and a light mitre cue.

knight.read: Cartoon zebra knight with black stripes on a cream pedestal.

pawn.read: Cartoon meerkat pawn on a cream pedestal with a simple collar.

sets.label: Legible
sets.theme: high-contrast flat silhouette, optimized for readability
sets.read: Bold, high-contrast graphic army built purely for visual legibility: each piece is a flat solid silhouette (black side pure black, white side pure white) wrapped in a thick outline of the opposite tone, so type and color both read instantly even at small size or from a distance.

king.read: Bold flat black silhouette king with a thick white outline, clear coronet and cross finial; designed for instant type recognition at a glance.

queen.read: Bold flat black silhouette queen with a thick white outline, clear coronet crown and ball finial; high-contrast graphic icon style.

rook.read: Bold flat black silhouette rook with a thick white outline and distinct crenellated battlement top on a wide base.

bishop.read: Bold flat black silhouette bishop with a thick white outline, clear mitre top, diagonal slit, and ball finial.

knight.read: Bold flat black silhouette knight with a thick white outline, horse head facing right on a chunky base.

pawn.read: Bold flat black silhouette pawn with a thick white outline, simple ball head, collar ring, and wide base.
